issues.description: The frozen inventory contains the datasheet, DLRTW_code.do, an identifier list and online appendix, but not the 24 project-relative inputs read by the supplied 16-stage code. The identifier-list probe is a dscode-only file-metadata sample, not an analysis panel. Frozen catalog checks found a readable Worldscope annual candidate and current ASSET4/BoardEx tables, but no author-file/field/history mapping; product-page checks are descriptive only. Orbis prepared panels, FactSet ownership, Datastream free-float panel, country sources, governance line items, family/SASB/cross-list files and SP-ES panel remain unverified. Catalog misses are not evidence of absent entitlements or data.

Step 8 consumes stata/datasets/boardex_panel27august_all, but no supplied step constructs that panel. The frozen catalog has regional BoardEx source families and a readable North American organization-summary candidate; its CompanyID/BoardID/AnnualReportDate/GenderRatio schema does not provide the author panel producer, non-US coverage, boardex_companyid mapping or the full Step 16 board/governance fields.
The code changes directory to the author laptop path before using relative data and output paths. A staged project root and coherent host-visible directory tree are required.

Step 14 consumes stata/datasets/SP-ES-2020-11-27, but the supplied code has no producer and the frozen catalog has no matching prepared panel. The datasheet identifies SAM S&P Global as the alternative E/S source; current product documentation does not establish the prepared panel's entity_key/year coverage or E_SPGlobal/S_SPGlobal mapping. The 2020 filename/date is provenance only, not a byte-identical vintage requirement.

The supplied code invokes mmerge for entity/year and identifier joins. The bounded Stata 18 `which mmerge` probe returned 111, so the exact command is not currently available on Stata's ado path. A compatible documented mmerge implementation or approved equivalent with the same merge behavior is needed before a future authorized run.

evidence.description: Step 1 reads the Worldscope panel and excludes US firms from the construction.
evidence.quote:
use "data/worldscope/worldscope-1-19-2018", clear
drop if year<2000
drop if ccode == "USA"

evidence.description: Step 1 imports the ASSET4 header file and saves the normalized header intermediate.
evidence.quote:
*** Import header file
import delimited "data/header/Header_15feb18.csv", clear 
sort entity_key
save "data/header/header2_new", replace

evidence.description: Step 1 joins the header crosswalk to Worldscope by entity_key.
evidence.quote:
*** Do merge on worldscope identifier
mmerge entity_key using "data/header/header2_new"
keep if _merge == 3
drop _merge
order worldscopepermid - samefirm, after(yq)
sort asset4companyid year
save "stata/datasets/worldscope_merge", replace

evidence.description: Step 2 constructs environmental outcome leads from the next panel observation.
evidence.quote:
*** Convert Contemperaneous E Scores to Lead Variables
bysort panelid: gen e1_lead = F.overall_e
bysort panelid: gen e2_lead = F.ENVSCORE
bysort panelid: gen e3_lead = F.ENER
bysort panelid: gen e4_lead = F.ENPI
bysort panelid: gen e5_lead = F.ENRR
bysort panelid: gen enviro_er_score_lead = F.enviro_er_score*100
bysort panelid: gen enviro_rr_score_lead = F.enviro_rr_score*100
bysort panelid: gen enviro_pi_score_lead = F.enviro_pi_score*100
bysort panelid: gen e_material_lead = F.overall_e_material

evidence.description: Step 3 reads and prepares the FactSet institutional ownership panel.
evidence.quote:
*** Clean Factset Ownership Panel
use "data/factset/holdings_by_firm_msci_Hannes_13Nov2017", clear
gen year = floor(quarter/100)
gen quarter2 = quarter- year*100
gen yq = yq(year,quarter2)
format yq %tq
drop cusip isin sedol quarter year quarter2
drop if factset_entity_id == ""
sort factset_entity_id yq
keep factset_entity_id io- yq

evidence.description: Step 4 reads the two differently dated Orbis panels, including the non-US 2005–2008 branch.
evidence.quote:
use "stata/datasets/worldscope_merge", clear
keep entity_key year isin1 isin2 isin3 isin4 sedol1 sedol2 sedol3 sedol4
save "stata/datasets/worldscope_orbis_merge", replace

*** Merge on isin1
use "data/orbis/orbis_annualpanel", clear
drop if year<2009
drop if ISINNumber == ""
rename ISINNumber isin1
bysort isin1 year: keep if _n == _N
mmerge isin1 year using "stata/datasets/worldscope_orbis_merge"

evidence.description: Step 8 joins a BoardEx panel with no producer among the enumerated stages.
evidence.quote:
* Step 8: Merge BoardEx Panels to Worldscope Panel
***********************************************************************************************************

*** Merge Overall BoardEx Traits
joinby boardex_companyid year using "stata/datasets/boardex_panel27august_all", unma(ma)

evidence.description: Step 16 saves the prepared sample output.
evidence.quote:
*** Save
duplicates report entity_key year
compress
save "stata/datasets/sample-7-17-21", replace

items from ASSET4 that are material according to the SASB Materiality Map. The SAM S&P Environmental Score
and the Sustainalytics Environment Score are obtained from SAM S&P Global and Sustainalytics, respectively. The

measure firms’ environmental performance relative to other companies for the categories Emission Reduction,
Resource Reduction, and Product Innovation. The ASSET4 Equal-weighted Environmental Category Scores for the
categories Emission Reduction, Resource Reduction, and Product Innovation are calculated as the sum of all indicator
variables in each category divided by the number of reported items times 100. All variables are described in

evidence.quote:
This table reports regression estimates of environmental scores on governance mechanisms and control variables. The
dependent variable is the natural logarithm of the ASSET4 Equal-weighted Environmental Score calculated as the
average of three category scores (Emission Reduction, Resource Reduction, and Product Innovation). Models 1 to 4
use the full sample and model 5 includes firm fixed effects and only uses firms where Majority Election or Female
Director are time-varying during the sample period. Online Appendix Table OA-1 describes the indicator variables
used to calculate the environmental scores. All variables are described in Appendix A. The sample period is 2004-
2015. All variables are winsorized at the 1st and 99th percentiles. All right-hand side variables are lagged by one year.
